svg.title: From the H–x chart to the T–x–y diagram (ethanol–water, 1 kg/cm²)
svg.text: From the H–x chart to the T–x–y diagram (ethanol–water, 1 kg/cm²)
Ethanol–water enthalpy–composition chart at 1 kg/cm² (after Bosnjakovic; Wankat Fig. 2-4), redrawn
Auxiliary line for interpolating equilibrium compositions
Weight fraction ethanol (x liquid, y vapor)
T–x–y diagram built from the tie lines (same x axis)
On the H–x chart pick a labelled tie line (here 85 °C).
Its lower end is on the boiling line: drop down to the T–x–y diagram and plot (x = 0.25, 85 °C).
Its upper end is on the dew line: drop down and plot (y = 0.68, 85 °C).
The tie line becomes a horizontal line at 85 °C; repeat for the other tie lines and join the points.
Redrawn from the chart data (curves fitted to the readings used in the solutions); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
